rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst and notes zona thinning, ICM, and TE, but includes hedging and some speculative features not clearly verifiable from a single image.
Integrates age, AMH, endometrial thickness, diagnosis, semen parameters, BMI, and cycle context well, with appropriate emphasis on thin endometrium as the main limiting factor.
Overall logical, but there are internal inconsistencies around implantation vs clinical pregnancy/live birth ranges and some mixed statements about stage 3 vs stage 4 expansion.

Mostly aligned on embryo grading, single embryo transfer, and caution about morphology not equaling euploidy, but some recommendations (e.g., immediate estradiol/aggressive luteal support framing) are not clearly guideline-based for this exact scenario.
Provides practical next steps for transfer, lining optimization, uterine evaluation, and future-cycle planning, though some suggestions remain somewhat general rather than protocol-specific.
